column2: [intro]
Sitting in my chair, lost in endless thought,
Reflex ideas, they just can’t be caught.
A fog settles in, my mind’s in a mess,
I search for solutions, but find none, I confess.
Oh, the reflex ideas, playing in my brain,
They race around, like a curious game.
Thoughts are swirling in my confused mind,
Reflex ideas, they drive me a bit blind!
When I sleep at night, plagued by doubt,
Reflex ideas throw me about.
I wake up suddenly, questions all around,
Reflex ideas, they never seem to calm down.
Oh, the reflex ideas, playing in my brain,
They race around, like a curious game.
Thoughts are swirling in my confused mind,
Reflex ideas, they drive me a bit blind!
[ solo ]
So I laugh at myself, at these whimsical thoughts,
I play with my ideas, even if they’re fraught.
For in this world that’s so serious,
Reflex ideas are my little game, so curious!
[outro]
